scripts.test:license01: find $(find projects -depth -name 'src' | grep -v node_modules) -name '*.ts'  -exec grep -L "^ \* Copyright (c) 2026 Manuel García Criado" {} \;
scripts.test:license02: find $(find projects -depth -name 'src' | grep -v node_modules) -name '*.ts'  -exec grep -L "^ \* SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT" {} \;
scripts.test:license03: find . -name 'README.md' -not -path '*/node_modules/*'  -exec grep -L "^This project is licensed under the MIT License - see the \[LICENSE\](LICENSE) file for details\." {} \;
